CARDIOLOGY CONSULT

Seen in consultation on 11/07/2026. Patient Harold Brennan, MRN 55-90212,
is a 91-year-old male admitted after syncope. Dr. Elena Vasquez asked us
to evaluate. ECG from 11/06/26 shows AFib with rapid response.

Plan: rate control, anticoagulation, echo ordered. Follow-up clinic visit
12/01/2026 at Riverbend Heart Center; call 555-019-4427 with questions.

text:
NEUROLOGY CONSULT - the ambiguity showcase note

Dr. Felicity Huntington referred Olive Parkinson (age 71, husband Gerald
Parkinson) for tremor evaluation on 12/12/2025. Her mother had Parkinson's
disease; her brother carries Huntington disease. Dr. Huntington wondered
whether this is early Parkinson disease versus essential tremor.

Olive is 71, her father died at 88, and her aunt Sarah lived to 94. The
aunt's care was managed by Dr. Malcolm Graves, who also treats Graves
disease. Symptoms began 3 days post-op and worsened over the past month;
follow-up visit is scheduled 02/06/2026, i.e. 8 weeks from now.

Contact: movement-disorders scheduler 555-013-7700 or
scheduler@neuro-example-health.org; patient portal
neuro.example-health.org/movement-disorders. Signed: A. Whitcomb, MD.
